verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents building custom assistants that carry their own instructions and knowledge base, or sharing such assistants with others. The closest item is a help-centre index line about creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills (kimi-docs-13). That is a related but different feature, with no evidence that it bundles a persona or instructions with knowledge into a shareable assistant. File-based Q&A (kimi-file-qa-20261106) is per-conversation document upload, not a reusable custom assistant.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
